_comment: How a Mesa honeykrisp (Asahi Vulkan) compute shader finds its inputs, for `spirv_task.py sim`. UNVERIFIED SKETCH:
the agent on Asahi fills the real layout for its Mesa build into spirv/root_layout.json (tasks/spirv-workloads.md).
Known from the stored control shader (novel-results/2026-10-04-first-agx-instruction, Mesa 25.3.6): the preamble
loads root-table words 20..22 (device_load idx 5, lsl 2) into u4, word 124 (idx 31, lsl 2) into u5 (the element
count there), and 4 words at u2_u3 into u6..u7 (the output buffer address). Word numbers are 32-bit word indices.
value kinds: const:N, groups:x|y|z, grid:x|y|z (threads), wg:x|y|z, base:x|y|z (= 0), push (the push-constant
bytes), set (descriptor set VA), buffer:B (VA of binding B), buffer_size:B.
